name: Chiseled Enchanting Table (Unofficial 26.3 Port)
description: Unofficial community port of Sacramentix's Chiseled Enchanting Table to Minecraft 26.3 / Fabric. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author. A rework of enchantment progression: you can now enchant your gear using enchanted books placed in nearby chiseled bookshelves using a chiseled enchanting table.

custom.chiseled_enchanting_table:port_notes: Unofficial community port to Minecraft 26.3. 1.0.3: JSON-driven chest / archaeology loot injection, live structure bookshelf replacement/fill, score-based shelf-facing, vanilla-anvil-style XP point deduction, vanilla enchanting-table book blocking, narrow anvil book+book same-level merge blocking, and enchanted-book chiseled-bookshelf random-tick particles/sound. 26.3 adaptations: renderpearl-era PoseStack#rotate/rotateDegrees, 9-arg SubmitNodeCollector#submitModel plus a separate crumbling-overlay submit, ContextIntProviders/UniformContainerBase loot builder API, Optional<Holder<LootItemCondition>> conditional loot functions, hand-rolled payload collection codecs (FriendlyByteBuf collection helpers removed), 26.3 loot-table schema (condition/modifier + type) and recipe_crafted 'recipes' list. Active mixins live in chiseled-enchanting-table-port.mixins.json. Still parked: broader anvil XP-cost tweak, Colorful Books integration, enchanted-book stack-size accessor. See CURRENT_BASELINE.md for the capability boundary, docs/reports/PORTING_26_3_REPORT.md for the migration evidence, and docs/EXTENDING.md for data-driven customisation entry points.
